IDENT.title: Priced Timed Automata Models for Control of Intelligent Product Agents in Manufacturing Systems

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: A PA represents a single product and an RA represents a single resource on the plant floor (citing Kovalenko et al., 2019b; Zheng et al., 2018).
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: A PA represents a single product and an RA represents a single resource on the plant ﬂoor (Kovalenko et al., 2019b; Zheng

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: A PA represents a single product and an RA represents a single resource on the plant ﬂoor (Kovalenko et al., 2019b; Zheng

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: two important decision-making agents for this strategy are product agents (PAs) and resource agents (RAs)

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: Each station, robot, and buﬀer has an RA that makes the high-level control decisions for the resource

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: The PA gathers, stores, and updates a model of the environment for decision making

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: This work proposes a priced timed automata modeling framework to represent an environment model for a product agent.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: The PA uses an SMT-based solver to obtain the optimal path on the environment model and send requests to RAs.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: Current PA modeling approaches do not capture this information, as adding the states and events to the model would result in state explosion.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: test the performance of PAs in the Repast Symphony simulation platform

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: The process plan and key performance weights are provided to the PA once the lot enters the system.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: PA holds process plan, key performance weights, and a continuously updated PTA environment model; no historical log.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: The process plan and key performance weights are provided to the PA once the lot enters the system.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: a PA creates the environment model by dynamically requesting and synthesizing information from the resource agents (RAs) in the system

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: The product agent uses a continuously updated model of the local manufacturing system to make decisions.

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote: Finally, the PA exits the system via the exit buﬀer.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: The environment model is built and updated on-the-ﬂy as a PA communicates with RAs

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: this environment model must accurately represent the abilities and limitations of the manufacturing system

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: The events, E, represent PA to RA requests for manufacturing or logistic operations

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the RAs must calculate the constraints and costs of the manufacturing operations when requested.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: There are 3 RAs, one for each resource, that communicate with the PA and control the resources in this system.

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: The PAs obtain and update a PTA-based environment model by exploring (Kovalenko et al., 2019a) the system through communication with the RAs.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: the PTA-based PA was tested in a simulation of a semiconductor manufacturing facility.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: For the PTAbased PA, 150/150 lots were successfully completed.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: The PTA-based PA was compared to the FSM-based PA previously tested in this simulation

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: The simulated manufacturing facility has 6 bays of 20 manufacturing stations connected by 9 material handling robots

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: A scaled up version of Intel Mini-Fab, a semiconductor manufacturing facility

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: PAs leverage this solver for decision making by ﬁnding the optimal path on a continuously updated environment model.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Extends the FSM-based reference PA model with priced timed automata: clocks, hard/soft time constraints with slack, multi-metric weighted costs, solved via SMT instead of Dijkstra.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: this work describes a PA environment model that leverages the PTA modeling formalism to encode time-based constraints and costs

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Environment model must accurately represent system abilities/limitations; RAs must compute constraints and costs.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: To enable eﬀective PA decision making, the RAs must calculate the constraints and costs of the manufacturing operations when requested.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: The PA gathers, stores, and updates a model of the environment for decision making (Kovalenko et al., 2019b).

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: When a wafer lot is deposited into the enter buﬀer, a PA is created to control the individual lot.
